info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程提供修習航空工程之學生關於燃燒學之學理介紹。授課內容包含有1.層流預混火焰，介紹火焰的基本概念、統御方程式、火焰傳播速度、火焰厚度及火焰結構等2. 層流擴散火焰：描述噴流火焰、油滴蒸發與燃燒之物理特性與數學模式與應用等。其中因課程需要將補充一些熱力學的基本概念、熱質傳及化學動力特性等。
description.describe_eh: Develop an understanding of combustion in aerospace engineering. Topics covered include: 1-Laminar Premixed Flames: Introduce the fundamental concepts of flames, governing equations, flame speed, flame thickness and flame structure. 2-Laminar diffusion flames: Describe the physical characteristics and mathematic model of jet flame, and droplet evaporation and burning. To facilitate students' understanding, we will review some fundamentals of thermodynamics, heat & mass transfer and chemical kinetics.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解層流預混火焰的基本特性、統御方程式的推導、火焰的結構與傳遞等
targets.describe_en: Understand the fundamental concepts of laminar premixed flames, the govern equations, the structure of flame, and the speed of flame propagation.

targets.describe_ch: 描述層流擴散火焰的物理特性、基本假設與統御方程式、油滴的蒸散與燃燒
targets.describe_en: Describe the physical characteristics, assumptions and mathematic model of laminar jet flame, and droplet evapo- ration and burning.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由對火焰的基本瞭解，衍伸到燃燒爐的設計與應用
targets.describe_en: After understanding some fundamental features of premixed and diffusion flames, the design project of a stove is given as an exam or term paper.

targets.describe_ch: 具備口頭報告其分析成果之能力
targets.describe_en: To be capable of making a fine presentation of their analysis works to their classmates and instructor

targets.describe_ch: 使學生對燃燒理論之應用有相當之瞭解。
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of the application of combustion theory
